create_Table_for_algebraic_reasoning: create a Table instance to manage symbolic expressions and solve linear equality constraints via MILP traceback
use_RatioTable_for_length_ratios: use a RatioTable to track and derive equalities between logarithmic distance ratios of geometric segments
use_AngleTable_for_directions: use an AngleTable to track slope direction equalities and derive parallel or constant-angle relationships modulo pi
use_DistanceTable_for_congruences: use a DistanceTable to track point position congruences on lines and derive constant ratio relationships
use_update_groups_for_equivalence: use update_groups to merge sets of equivalent elements and return the links that caused each merge
